inputs.text: [angry] You recognized it. Don't tell me to watch my feet. I am watching my feet, and I'm asking you what that mark is.
[defensive] It's a Malfoy ward. I thought it was dead. I didn't think there was anything left that could do this.
[angry] Your family's magic is firing arrows at us, and you were going to wait until when to tell me? Until another one missed?
[defensive] I recognized it just now. You saw me recognize it. Don't turn that into me knowing everything before you walked into the room.
[angry] You knew to pull me into the dance. You knew not to stop. Every time I ask something, there's another thing you haven't said.
[defensive] I saw what happened to the people who stopped. That's not the same as knowing how to undo it. I am frightened too, Harry.
[angry] Then tell me what you know, even if it isn't enough. I can deal with you being frightened. I can't deal with guessing which answers you're keeping from me.
[defensive] I know whose ward it is. I thought it couldn't work anymore. I don't know who's using it now. That's what I can tell you.
[angry] All right. Then we start there. But if you recognize something else, I need to hear it before I have to ask.
[defensive] Behind you. Harry, raise your wand. Those strings are coming straight at us.
